summary: Backend testing of WhatsApp appointment reminders. Created /app/backend/tests/test_whatsapp_reminders.py with 13 pytest cases covering all 11 requirements from the review request. All 13 tests PASSED (100%). Endpoints verified: GET /api/clinic/appointments/whatsapp-reminders (default structure, window cap at 168h, auth), POST /whatsapp-reminder-sent (200, 404 for missing/other-clinic, removes from queue, include_sent shows already_sent=true), POST /whatsapp-reminder-reset (restores to queue), phone normalization to 502... for Guatemala local 8-digit numbers, patient-without-phone skipped, cancelled appointments excluded, and GET /api/clinic/user-guide/pdf regression passes with valid %PDF header.

minor.issue: Response echoes the requested window_hours (999) even though internal window is capped at 168h. Not incorrect but could mislead the UI. Consider returning the effective capped value.
When appointments list is empty, response omits `skipped_no_phone` (early return only includes appointments/count/window_hours). Should always include skipped_no_phone=0 for consistent API contract.

action_items: (Optional) Always return skipped_no_phone (default 0) even when appointments list is empty for consistent response shape.
(Optional) Consider returning the effective capped window_hours (min(requested, 168)) instead of echoing the raw request value.
critical_code_review_comments: appointments.py grew to 882 lines; consider splitting WhatsApp reminders + main appointments into separate modules.
Phone normalization is imported inside the endpoint function; fine but a top-level import would be cleaner.
The endpoint filters skipped_no_phone with a second loop over apts — duplicate iteration; can be tallied inside the main loop.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 TEST_-prefixed patients (TEST_WA and TEST_WA_NOP) with unique last_names per run. Appointments created during tests were cleaned up (status=cancelled) at teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_whatsapp_reminders.py is a full regression suite for WhatsApp reminders. It logs in as clinic_admin, finds a doctor via /api/clinic/members, creates patients and appointments in MAIN branch 79c47aab..., and cancels appointments at teardown. If clinic schedule changes, adjust _next_business_slot() to pick valid slots. All tests currently pass.
